The Client Confidence badge on our homepage reads 2019–2024, from Regional Advisor Review, a publication that rates advisers every year. We did not receive the rating in 2021 or 2022, and the badge does not say when any year's rating was given or what period it covered. No fee was paid to be considered for the rating and nothing is paid to display it. We reviewed the survey questionnaire before using the rating and have a reasonable basis to believe it is structured to make favorable and unfavorable responses equally easy and is not designed to produce a predetermined result.
